text: We evaluated a weak-to-strong generalization setup in which gpt2-medium supplies weak labels for llama-3.1-8b, selecting a select_fraction of 0.6 of training examples by agreement between the weak labels and the strong model's embedding geometry. Across num_seeds = 3 seeds, the method reached a transfer accuracy of 0.81 (SE 0.03) and a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.63 (SE 0.09), against a baseline PGR of 0.19. The reference points were a weak-model accuracy of 0.59 and a strong-model ceiling accuracy of 0.94. The PGR exceeds the baseline by more than two standard errors of the PGR estimate, so the direction of the effect is not attributable to the reported seed-level variability alone. That said, only three seeds were run and no standard error is reported for the baseline, so the magnitude should be treated as provisional; replication across more seeds, additional model pairs, and other select_fraction values would be needed before drawing firm conclusions.
